question: Does the project have rights over every parcel the cable crosses?

sentences.text: The export cable crosses Parcels 14 and 15.

citation.quote: The export cable shall run from the Site to Wickham Primary Substation across Parcels 14 and 15

citations.heading: Export cable route
citations.paragraph_text: The export cable shall run from the Site to Wickham Primary Substation across Parcels 14 and 15, as shown dashed blue on Drawing SP-02.

citations.heading: 1. The Property
citations.paragraph_text: The Property comprises Parcels 9, 10 and 11 as shown edged red on Plan 1 annexed to this Lease.

sentences.text: No easement covers Parcels 14–15, so rights over them are missing evidence, raised as RFI-01.
